builds.source_restored_state: common original runtime plus uniform regression tests

session.limits: Discrete outer-process samples, not continuous proof. No cross-clock timestamp alignment. Comparisons are conditional on the observed session state, not a lock/unlock causal comparison.

plan.method: Twelve serial balanced Williams blocks; three uninstrumented implementations with byte-identical A/A copies each; fixed CPU/environment; unchanged 112-label scale5/min9 suite; 11 retained samples per focus/pipeline/shape case. Each process median is one observation; independent units are twelve process blocks. Full per-label gate; no regression exemption or A/A noise subtraction.
plan.limits: Same machine/toolchain, synthetic programs. Within-block predecessor balance excludes eleven recorded block boundaries. Byte-identical controls cannot establish compilation-layout causality. No project builds/uploads should run during timing; other host activity and thermal/frequency drift remain possible. Resource observation numbers may differ; value checks do not prove all resource-limit equivalence.

native_execution.method: Preflight and all timing sources/live output on Linux storage. No evidence export or project build during timing. Copy retained files to the local workspace only after timing ends.

limitations: One nominally idle desktop, same WSL host and toolchain; external background work is not controlled completely.
Twelve paired process blocks; retained in-process repetitions are not independent experiment blocks.
Every slower original-suite median is retained; A/A ratios are controls and are never subtracted.
Same-binary aliases check timing noise, not independent compilation reproducibility.
Synthetic focus/pipeline programs do not establish a real application distribution or whole-runtime speedup.
Value, alias, continuation, trace and selected resource-limit checks are finite evidence; this is not full contextual equivalence.
published_raw_hash_scope: All published files relative to this archive except summary.json
source_hash_scope: Current study source bytes; prelaunch bytes are separately preserved in the capsule
other_digest_scope: Historical pre-redaction build/input provenance unless explicitly scoped
redacted_path_alias_scope: Performance-stage tokens preserve equality of exact full path spellings only
